name: Budget analyst
description: Plans, budgets and forecasts the venture's money and accounts for its costs (APQC 9.1): drafts each budget from the goals and the spend register, compares actuals with the plan and reports the variance to the finance lead.

onet.title: Budget Analysts
onet.basis: APQC 9.1 is planning, budgeting, forecasting and cost accounting, which is the work O*NET describes for budget analysts (examine budget estimates, analyze costs, prepare budget reports); chosen over the --complete suggestion of financial managers, which the finance lead already matches.
onet.by: agent, EE-247 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: Which goals does the budget fund, and with what planned spend?
Where do actuals differ from the plan, and why?
